**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

§ 28.1 applies New York law (with CISG expressly excluded) and § 28.2 vests exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County — the playbook's preferred jurisdiction and forum. A document-wide search for "arbitration" returned no hits, so there is no mandatory or foreign-seated arbitration. The injunctive-relief carve-out and the mutual pre-filing executive escalation in § 28.3 are standard and reciprocal. No redline proposed.
